title: done's ledger check reports an _anchors.csv row an item added and a later commit dropped as added
goal: done's ledger check counts a ledger row by its net change over the item's commits, so a row that one commit adds and a later commit removes names no source

clauses.clause: done's ledger check counts a ledger row by its net change over the item's commits, so a row that one commit adds and a later commit removes names no source

notes: Goal before the 2026-10-17 plan: ledger_change returns ['added'] for an _anchors.csv row absent both at the first parent and at HEAD (b and a both None, b is None tested first), so ledger_moves names a row an item's commit added and a later commit dropped though its net change is nothing, against its docstring's 'a later revert clears it' (SP-ia6xayiy review, S2, from BG-ph7dcjhz's per-commit rewrite): a row absent at both ends counts no change Plan 2026-10-17: repro on origin/main b871374b4 exits 1 ({'S900': ['_anchors.csv: added']}). Carries ST-foicg7mg (the same defect seen at landings in SP-xo45jvbj and SP-6jfnx5i3: rows of S1864, S704, S718, S2157 and three S- ids added then removed, refused as outside-touches), dropped as its duplicate.
